technology_name: A Micronutrient Composition for Ginger and a Process for Its Preparation (Soils with pH Below Seven)
problem_solved: Micronutrient deficiencies in ginger cultivated in acidic soils
description: Micronutrient formulation developed for ginger production in soils with pH below seven. The technology is intended to support nutrient management and crop performance under acidic soil conditions.
applications:
Micronutrient fertilizer and specialty plant nutrition manufacturers
Ginger cultivation and commercial spice farming enterprises
Agricultural input companies and crop nutrition service providers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and spice grower cooperatives
Government agriculture departments and soil fertility management programs
